channel.title: Equatorial Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Equatorial Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: Equatorial Guinea joins Russia-Africa summit action plan
item.description: Leaders agreed a joint action plan for 2027-2029 and discussed economic cooperation.

item.title: Malabo conference promotes disaster prevention knowledge
item.description: Government, business, and university representatives met in Malabo to discuss disaster preparedness.

item.title: Equatorial Guinea Senate approves press freedom law
item.description: The new regulation aims to protect journalists, establish clear duties, and promote rigorous reporting.

item.title: Cronos Airlines cancels Malabo flights
item.description: Passengers stranded at Malabo airport face uncertainty as technical issues ground flights to Bata.

item.title: BEAC sets deadline for old CFA franc coins
item.description: Central African states have one year to exchange old 1 to 500 CFA franc coins for new currency.
